tools.name: deslop
tools.description: Edits pasted prose with server-side scoring and source-preservation checks. Cloudflare Workers AI handles hosted editing first. If it cannot return a usable edit, the service may send the draft and editing inputs through OpenRouter to a free model provider that may keep the draft and the edit or use

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "deslop" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Processes pasted prose with server-side scoring and source-preservation checks, plus bounded hosted AI editing when needed. Inputs are text, genre, and an optional audience. Returns edited or unchanged text, exact before-and-after writing scores, completed-check metadata, and review warnings when ed" → after: "Edits pasted prose with server-side scoring and source-preservation checks. Cloudflare Workers AI handles hosted editing first. If it cannot return a usable edit, the service may send the draft and editing inputs through OpenRouter to a free model provider that may keep the draft and the edit or use"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
